research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Gilead Sciences is researching and developing bridged tricyclic carbamoylpyridone compounds and capsid inhibitors for the treatment and prevention of HIV, as well as pharmaceutical formulations of bictegravir and lenacapavir. Their work includes SARS-CoV-2 main protease inhibitors, antiviral indolinyl compounds, and methods for treating viral infections such as hepatitis B, respiratory syncytial virus, and poxvirus. These efforts span small molecules, antibodies, and immunogenic compositions for critical diseases.

overview_description.description:
Gilead Sciences is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, and commercializes innovative medicines to address unmet medical needs. With each discovery and experimental drug candidate, they seek to improve the care of patients suffering from life-threatening diseases.

Gilead's primary areas of focus include HIV/AIDS, liver disease, and serious cardiovascular and respiratory conditions.

about_short_description.short_description: Gilead Sciences develops and markets biopharmaceutical therapies, focusing on antiviral, oncology, and inflammatory diseases.

product.name: Biktarvy
product.description: A once-daily, single-tablet HIV-1 treatment combining three antiretroviral medicines to suppress the virus in adults and eligible children.

product.name: Gilead HIV Treatment Portfolio
product.description: Antiretroviral medicines for treating HIV-1 infection, including Descovy, Genvoya, Odefsey, Symtuza, Truvada and Sunlenca.

product.name: Epclusa
product.description: An oral, fixed-dose combination antiviral used to treat chronic hepatitis C across all major viral genotypes in eligible patients.

product.name: Vosevi
product.description: A combination antiviral treatment for adults with chronic hepatitis C who have previously received certain direct-acting antiviral therapies.

product.name: Yescarta
product.description: An autologous CAR T-cell therapy used to treat certain relapsed or refractory B-cell blood cancers.

product.name: Trodelvy
product.description: An antibody-drug conjugate used to treat certain advanced or metastatic breast and urothelial cancers.
